text:
Samir: quick async standup — onboarding synthia-v3 (tinyq) smoke today
Samir: what I did: ran 500-sample onboard suite, KV warmup, and promptset sweep for en/es. found ~6% BLEU drop on es tests vs baseline.
Samir: blockers: Spanish promptset shows tokenization mismatch (missing accent normalization) and one eval case times out intermittently (looks like KV cache miss from warmup stage).
Samir: today: will push a tiny tokenizer normalize patch, re-run full eval, and open a PR with config to force KV prewarm for the job. pinging for quick review if green.
Priya: thanks — can you drop the eval artifacts and the failing example?
Samir: uploaded artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/synthia-v3/3265/ — failing example inline:
```
input: "¿Dónde está la estación?"
expected: "La estación está a dos cuadras."
model: "Donde esta la estacion."  # missing accents, lower BLEU
```
Samir: repro run I used:
`python tools/eval_runner.py --model synthia-v3-tinyq --prompts tests/es_small.json --warmup 200 --save-artifact 3265`
Michael: small heads-up — I have a PR touching tokenizer normalizer (PR #867). if Samir's change overlaps I can rebase. @Samir can you paste the diff you plan?
Samir: will open PR in a few mins. planned change is 3 lines in tokenizer/normalizer.py to run unicodedata.normalize('NFKC') + accent preservation for es. tiny change, no model code.
Samir: also adding a job config tweak to set `kv_prewarm: true` for synthia-v3 onboard runs so warmup hits the same host affinity.
Michael: noted, I'll review fast. if tests pass I'll merge and trigger onboard job.
eng-bot: CI started for PR #867 — checks: lint, unit, eval-smoke.
Lu: if we're seeing intermittent timeouts, should we enable fallback routing to synthia-v2 for the production route until this is fixed?
Samir: I'd prefer not to fallback prod yet — this is limited to the onboard test harness. but for safety I can add a canary rollout to dedicated/test region and a short TTL cache for model route.
Priya: timeline? if fixed today we can re-run and unblock next week's Dedicated capacity test.
Samir: aiming to merge within 2h and re-run full eval by EOD. will @channel if any regression persists. :thumbsup:
